remarks: Updated 2/2 double with off street parking & a fantastic opportunity for investors or owner occupants alike! This well-maintained two family property features two spacious 2 bedroom, 1 bath units, each thoughtfully updated with modern finishes throughout. Both apartments boast updated kitchens with newer cabinetry, stylish tile backsplashes, updated fixtures and tile flooring. The fully renovated bathrooms offer fresh tile work, updated vanities and attractive finishes. Newly installed hardwood flooring adds warmth and character, while energy-efficient windows fill the interiors with natural light. Additional improvements include updated PEX plumbing and separate 100-amp electrical panels for each unit. Full beasement with solid mechanicas & seperate laundry hook-ups. Outside, enjoy long driveway offering ample off-street parking and a large fully fenced backyard with plenty of room to relax or entertain. Conveniently located minutes from ECMC this move in ready property offers an excellent opportunity to generate rental income or live in one unit while renting the other.
